items.title: Palantir and Nvidia Are Restricting Anthropic’s AI. Microsoft Could Win the Enterprise Trust War
items.summary: Palantir and Nvidia have reportedly tightened restrictions around Anthropic’s advanced AI models over data-retention concerns.
